contract: GMLI China M2 official-source candidate v2
purpose: Replace the opaque legacy China stitch prospectively with a reproducible PBoC-native M2 level history while preserving the existing GMLI seven-region architecture and evaluating the impact before any Core promotion.

methodology_policy.candidate_rule: Treat this as a new versioned production-source candidate. Compare it with the legacy benchmark; do not call it the missing historical exact rerun.
preferred_source_order: 2015 onward: PBoC Statistics -> year -> Money and Banking Statistics -> Money Supply -> HTML
2014 seed year only: official central PBoC monthly Financial Statistics Reports

history_contract.precision_history: 2015 onward uses official Money Supply table values in RMB 100 million directly.
history_contract.seed_year_2014: 2014 uses the M2 balance published in each official central PBoC monthly Financial Statistics Report, converted from trillion yuan to RMB 100 million. It is a rounded seed year used only to make 2015 YoY computable.
history_contract.seed_year_precision: 0.01 trillion yuan = 100 RMB 100-million units; do not claim 2014 has the same precision as the 2015+ HTML tables.
history_contract.seed_year_reason: The official 2014 Money and Banking Statistics overview is still discoverable, but its historical Money Supply HTML target currently returns 404. Missing historical bytes are not reconstructed.
history_contract.current_year_requirement: all populated M2 months through the latest official table update
history_contract.raw_byte_policy: Preserve the Statistics index and each 2015+ Money Supply HTML payload. For every 2014 seed month preserve the PBoC search payload and selected central-PBoC Financial Statistics article payload, source URLs, retrieval timestamp and SHA-256.
history_contract.no_proxy_rule: No OECD, commercial vendor, mirror or reconstructed legacy series may fill 2014.

known_breaks.description: PBoC improved the money-market-fund component of money supply statistics and retrospectively revised 2017 M2 growth for comparability. The official level tables remain the V2 accounting history; the break is explicitly recorded.
e-CNY was added to M0; PBoC states revised M1/M2 growth rates were not materially changed.
PBoC revised M1 definition; this contract uses M2 and records the break for provenance only.

current_cross_check.note: Rounded report values are a cross-check only for the 2015+ precision history.

seed_validation.source: Official central PBoC 2014-05 Financial Statistics Report
seed_validation.rule: The collected 2014-05 seed must equal the published 118.23 trillion yuan at report precision.

promotion_policy: A complete official V2 series may be used to construct a new Money candidate and rerun the locked transmission evaluation. Promotion, if justified, is a new version decision and does not alter the historical fact that the old v1.8b exact rerun was impossible.
